title: How Often Should Furnace Be Replaced
desc: For more information about furnace replacement or installation, contact Rosenberg Indoor Comfort and speak to one of our professionals!

blocks.text: Keeping your furnace in good working condition is the best way to ensure it has a long lifespan. Regular service and inspections keep it working efficiently and prevents the need for costly repairs. In some cases though, you will need to completely replace the unit if it is old or has significant damage as a result of neglect over time. So, how do you know when it’s time to replace the furnace?

In most cases, if the unit has had the proper installation and service over its lifetime, the average furnace can last anywhere from 18 to 20 years. This number is estimated and can vary depending on size, location, brand, and climate. The more you use the furnace, the less life the unit will have. People living in areas where the climate is very cold will need to replace their furnace more often than people living in a mild climate. If you want to get the most life out of your unit, schedule yearly inspections and maintenance services from a reputable company like Rosenberg HVAC in San Antonio, TX.

Some of the signs that it may be time to replace your furnace include inconsistent running, fluctuating bills, and cold spots. If your technician thinks your unit needs to be replaced, don’t wait. You should begin the process immediately and replace it with a new efficient unit like their American Standard furnace line. When you purchase one of their high-quality furnaces, you can expect to receive superior installation from skilled and licensed technicians, as well as lower utility bills and increased home comfort throughout the coming years. Don’t waste time with your old unit that may break at the worst time. Get an inspection and find out if a replacement is the right option for you.
